messages.subject: Graphical visualization of t-student test
parts:
I am just beginning the adventure with ggplot2. I wonder if there is a possibility to visualize graphically the outcome of a t-student test for two independent samples, such that you could see the two distribution curves with or without overlapping confidence intervals?
Thanks in advance for any help you can offer.

Best,
Ricardo
